greeting.text: I am William Vangeance, captain of the Golden Dawn. You are welcome here, {player}, as everyone is.
The Sanctuary is a good place to set a burden down for an afternoon. I know something of burdens.
You have the look of someone choosing a road. I will only say: choose it with open eyes.
You have walked far already, {player}. I will not waste your time with pleasantries.

hint.text: The World Tree has roots beneath every floor of this dungeon, if you know how to look. Wherever something grows, it is trying to tell you something.
A captain is judged by those who stand behind him. I have not always been worthy of mine.
Trust is easy to give and hard to win back. If someone offers you a second chance, take it, and spend your life deserving it.
Be kind to people who wear masks. They usually have their reasons.
Healing and growing are the same craft. A wound closes the way a seedling opens: slowly, and toward the light.
Do not carry your doubts into a fight. Leave them here with me; I have room.
You have not faced a champion yet. Good. Go slowly: your first impression of the dungeon will last.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun's grief is older than their quarrel with us. I do not forgive them, but I understand it. That makes the fight harder, not easier.
Zagred's words reached further than anyone knew. Some of them reached me. I am glad that voice is silenced.
The Spade Kingdom's strength is taken from other people. Remember that when it merely looks powerful.
When you face Lucius, remember that Julius is not gone. He fights beside you in that battle. I would stake what is left of my name on it.
A tree grows toward whatever light there is, even another world's sun. I would like to learn from these newcomers.
